record.reason: The transformer model addresses the efficiency bottleneck caused by sequential computation in traditional recurrent neural networks (RNN) by leveraging the self‐attention mechanism to parallelize the capture of global dependencies. The subword‐level modeling units and fixed‐pattern positional encoding adopted by mainstream methods struggle to adequately capture fine‐grained feature information in morphologically rich languages, limiting the model's flexible learning of target‐side word order patterns.
